Connor / team — quick readout after triage with the compliance team and our external auditor:

1) Current state: our most recently issued SOC 2 Type II covers audit period 2025-06-01 to 2026-05-31 (so it does not fully include Riverbend's requested 2026-06-01 to 2027-05-31 window). There is a 1-day gap (2026-06-01 vs our end 2026-05-31) and then we lack the later 2026-06 through 2027-05 attestation.

2) Options and recommended approach (fastest to unblock):
   - Option A (recommended short path): Provide a signed interim bridge letter attesting controls remain materially unchanged since last SOC 2 period AND coordinate a written confirmation from our external auditor that they are not aware of control exceptions since the last report. We can produce a bridge letter + auditor confirmation within 5 business days if we prioritize this and get legal to sign off on the template.
   - Option B (longer): Kick off an off-cycle attest engagement to produce a Type II covering 2026-06-01 to 2027-05-31 — this requires an auditor engagement and will take 6-8 weeks minimum.

3) Requirements from Sales/Legal: a signed bridge letter template, signature authority (CISO + CEO sign-off preferred), and explicit acceptance from Riverbend that a bridge + auditor confirmation is sufficient. We will provide the bridge as a short PDF (1 page) and can add an auditor note as a separate attachment.

I'll prepare the bridge-letter draft by end of day today and coordinate with our auditor for the confirmation. If Sales wants to offer credits or a temporary SLA commitment to make procurement comfortable, tell me the parameters and we will include a reference in the bridge.

— Monica Patel
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
